[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | map size=1.3 | ingame name=The Breach | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=102 }} [[The Breach]] is the simple name given to the area north where the [[Charr]] broke through the wall and invaded into the rest of [[Ascalon]]. Most of the once-green terrain has been scorched dry and the rivers tainted with [[tar]]. == Getting there == Characters will most likely venture into this area following the [[secondary quest]] [[Supplies for the Duke]]. It is reached by traveling due west from [[Ascalon City]] to the northwest corner of [[Old Ascalon]], then passing through the [[Hammer Gate]] to the north. == Shrines == ; [[Resurrection shrine]]s * Perhaps we will meet again soon.'' == Notes == * These quests will affect the spawns in this area: ** [[Charr Reinforcements]] ** [[Fallen Soldiers]] ** [[Hammer and Anvil]] ** [[Into the Breach]] ** [[Supplies for the Duke]] ** [[The Charr Staging Area]] ** [[The Siege of Piken Square]] * If any member of the party has started or completed Into the Breach, a squad of soldiers including an [[Academy Monk]] will spawn near the exit to [[Old Ascalon]]. If a [[minion master]] is in the party, the Academy Monk can be coaxed into following the party, as she will try to heal the minions. * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.3% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 130|low = 100|high = 134|notes=Has hidden Devourers and Crown of Thorns.}} *** There are several hidden [[Devourer]] groups concentrated near the [[Old Ascalon]] exit. *** A few hidden [[Crown of Thorns|Crowns of Thorns]] can be triggered in the southwestern area, in the slightly greener terrain. ** With patience, it is possible to bring a party of eight from [[Temple of the Ages]]. == Trivia == {{gw2w|Breachwater Lake}} * The eastern third of this map shares the same location as the westernmost portion of [[The Northlands]], an explorable area in [[Ascalon_(pre-Searing)|pre-Searing Ascalon]]. {{Explorable areas in Ascalon}} [[de:Die Bresche]]
